objects.description: [MailSniper](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0413) can be used to obtain account names from Exchange and Office 365 using the Get-GlobalAddressList cmdlet.(Citation: Black Hills Attacking Exchange MailSniper, 2016)
objects.description_fa: [MailSniper](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0413) می‌تواند برای دریافت نام حساب‌ها از Exchange و Office 365 با استفاده از cmdlet Get-GlobalAddressList استفاده شود.(Citation: Black Hills Attacking Exchange MailSniper, 2016)
